claims.statement: LuxNet's 2026-08-28 investor deck shows an EML line in pre-ramp: Optoway (誼虹, 10.6% shareholder, private) supplies EPI wafers, LuxNet processes them into EML chips, Optoway makes the EML laser, for an unnamed 'global leader in high-speed optical interconnect solutions'; initial shipments 2H26, volume ramp 2027 (issuer guidance). If realized it would add a third supply-side entrant to tech:eml beside Coherent and Lumentum — self-reported by the issuer only (L8: no sole_source, confidence capped).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：到 2027-06-30 為止，華星光的月營收說明、2026Q4／2027 法說或 2026 年報（約 2027-05）都沒有揭露 EML 晶片出貨，或揭露 EML 產線延後／取消。核查頻率：每月（月營收說明）＋每季（法說簡報）。觸發後 48 小時：重跑 python -m query.structure tech:eml，把 e1 降 confidence 或提撤回，並在 tech:eml 層讀圖註記 pre-ramp 未兌現。

claims.statement: LuxNet sells CW/EML chips as a 'Chip Foundry service' (p.24) and lists 'Foundry Business' among its main products (p.4); the design-side customers are not named. The capacity figures on p.24 (3K wafers 2025 → 6K 2026WE; 14KK chips 2025 → 30KK 2026E) are issuer estimates kept here as dated context only — not graph attributes (L4).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：後續法說或年報改稱 CW 晶片以自有品牌銷售、不再提代工，或揭露代工客戶終止。核查頻率：每季（法說簡報）＋每年（年報約 5 月）。觸發後 48 小時：重跑 python -m query.structure co:luxnet 與 tech:cw_dfb_laser，更新本 claim 與 CW DFB 層讀圖（sr_00e18cf604cc66b9 或其現行版）。

claims.statement: Optoway Technology (誼虹科技, private) is a 10.6% shareholder of LuxNet (deck p.25). LuxNet's FY2025 annual report (mops_4979_annual_report_2025) lists 誼虹科技股份有限公司 with 15,130,000 shares (10.63%, as of 115/3/31) and states that LuxNet's chairman is also Optoway's chairman — the EML flow is a related-party (captive) arrangement, not an arm's-length customer commitment.
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：華星光年報的主要股東名單不再列誼虹，或持股降到 5% 以下，或董事長不再同一人。核查頻率：每年（年報約 5 月）。觸發後 48 小時：e3 降 confidence 或提撤回，cl3 加註關係人關係已變。
